manifest.acquisition_method: Windowed range reads from official Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs; full 2.6 GB parent DEM was not downloaded
manifest.effective_resolution: See local effective-resolution raster and summary; not assumed equal to 20 m

interpretation: TMSI compares terrain-feature distributions, not complete spatial geomorphology.
